defects.actual: PR-v3 auto-fix comment claims description says forward lean/fold and flipped spine -18 to +18. ACTUAL description: Lean the torso back diagonally against the chair — backward, not forward. The auto-fix regex matched forward in Extend one leg forward (leg direction, not torso). Resulting torso flexion +32 deg (forward) contradicts the lean-back description.
L foot at y=-0.65 (above floor at y=-0.8). Instructions say extend one leg forward with foot on the floor — L leg is extended (hip 25 deg, knee 15 deg, nearly straight) but foot is 0.15 above floor.

failing_tests: torso_forward(torso flexion <= 0 OR < 8 for backward lean claim)
regression_risk: LOW — spine revert undoes PR-v3 mis-fix (description clearly says back diagonally). L leg straightened to reach floor; R leg unchanged. Arms unchanged (L arm overhead behind head approximation, R arm reaching forward). Note: geometry sweep flagged this as torso_forward false positive — manual review confirms description says back lean, not forward.
rationale: PR-v3 mis-fix regression: the description says Lean the torso back diagonally against the chair (backward) but PR-v3 auto-fix matched the word forward in Extend one leg forward (about legs, not torso) and incorrectly flipped spine from -18 (correct backward arch) to +18 (forward fold). Reverting spine to -18 restores torso flexion to -3 deg (slight backward lean, matching description). For the foot-on-floor claim: original L leg (leftHip 40, leftKnee 15) gives foot at y=-0.65 (above floor). Fix: reduce leftHip to 5 (thigh nearly vertical down) and leftKnee to 10 (shin nearly straight) — derived L foot y=-0.886 (planted on floor), L leg still extended forward (hip flexion -9 deg, knee 10 deg, both small). R leg unchanged (still bent, sitting on chair).
